prompts.title: Product photo scene prompt builder
prompts.description: Turn a product into a detailed, photorealistic scene prompt for an image generator, with lighting, surface, props and framing spelled out.

variables.label: Product
variables.default: A matte-black stainless steel insulated water bottle with a bamboo lid
variables.help: Material, color, shape, anything that must stay accurate

variables.label: Setting ideas
variables.default: wet slate, morning light, pine branches
variables.help: Leave blank to let the model choose

prompts.exampleOutput:
Prompt 1: Matte-black stainless steel insulated water bottle with a bamboo lid, standing upright on wet dark slate, fine water droplets on the body, a single pine branch lying to the left, soft window light from camera right with a gentle cool rim light on the lid, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens feel, camera at eye level with the bottle, calm premium outdoor mood, palette of charcoal, forest green and warm bamboo tan, large soft-focus negative space in the upper third for headline copy, 4:5 vertical, photorealistic commercial photography.
Negative: extra logos, distorted lid, floating objects, harsh specular glare, text artifacts.

Prompt 2: Same bottle seen from a low three-quarter angle on a weathered granite ledge, misty hillside blurred behind it, early-morning golden backlight creating a thin glowing edge along the steel, bamboo grain crisp in the foreground, cool-to-warm color contrast, 50mm lens feel, minimalist composition with the bottle on the lower right third, 4:5, high-end lifestyle advertising photograph.
Negative: duplicate bottles, hands, brand text, oversaturation.

Prompt 3: Top-down flat lay on pale linen with the bottle lying diagonally, a folded map, a small compass and a sprig of pine arranged with generous spacing, diffused overhead light, soft shadows falling lower left, muted earth palette, 4:5.
Negative: cluttered props, tilted horizon, plastic sheen.

Series tip: reuse the exact product description sentence at the start of every prompt. Keep lighting direction constant.
Assumptions: no logo on the bottle; no people in frame.
prompts.notes: Leading with an accurate product description stops generators from altering your product. Reuse that first sentence verbatim across prompts to keep a series consistent.

prompts.title: Logo concept brief and image prompts
prompts.description: Turn your brand story into three distinct logo directions, each with a design rationale and ready-to-use image prompts for a generator.

variables.label: What it does
variables.default: A small-batch coffee roaster that sells beans by subscription and runs one cafe

variables.label: Audience
variables.default: Young professionals who care about ethical sourcing

variables.label: Colors
variables.default: Deep green and cream; avoid brown

prompts.exampleOutput:
Concept table
1. Leaf-in-cup symbol: a fern frond forming the steam above a cup. Signals nature and warmth.
2. Wordmark "Fernwick": lowercase geometric letters, the "w" with a subtle leaf notch. Signals approachable craft.
3. Round badge: circular emblem with a stylized bean split by a fern vein. Signals tradition and quality.

Prompt 1: Minimal geometric vector logo, a single fern frond rising as steam from a simple round coffee cup, two colors only (deep green on cream), uniform medium line weight, rounded terminals, centered on plain white background, flat design, no gradients, no text, no shadows.

Prompt 2: Lowercase wordmark "fernwick" in a clean geometric sans serif, deep green, the letter w with a small leaf-shaped notch, even letter spacing, flat vector on white background, no extra symbols.

Prompt 3: Circular badge emblem, a coffee bean whose center line becomes a fern vein, thin concentric ring border, deep green and cream, flat vector, balanced symmetry, no text, white background.

Scaling: Concept 1 holds at 32px if the cup is simplified; concept 2 needs an icon variant using the "f"; concept 3 loses ring detail, drop the border at small sizes.
Recommendation: Concept 1 because it is the most distinctive and works in one color.
Assumptions: brand name will be added in a design tool for concepts 1 and 3.
prompts.notes: Asking for scaling and one-color behavior filters out pretty but unusable marks. Generators often misspell text, so the prompt keeps long lettering out of the image.

prompts.title: Consistent character sheet for image generators
prompts.description: Build a locked character description and reusable prompt blocks so the same character looks the same across every image or video clip.

variables.label: Character concept
variables.default: A retired lighthouse keeper turned sea-glass collector, gentle but stubborn
variables.help: Who they are in a sentence or two

variables.label: Must-keep details
variables.default: white beard, yellow oilskin coat, round wire glasses, a turquoise sea-glass pendant

variables.label: Scenes
variables.default: a rocky beach at dawn, a cluttered workshop, a rowboat in fog

prompts.exampleOutput:
Character lock: Painterly storybook illustration of a man in his late 60s, broad-shouldered and slightly stooped, weathered tan face with deep smile lines, thick white beard trimmed short, short white hair under a faded navy knit cap, round thin wire-frame glasses, bright yellow oilskin coat with brass buttons over a gray wool sweater, a turquoise sea-glass pendant on a leather cord, soft watercolor texture, warm muted palette.

Short form: elderly man, white beard, wire glasses, yellow oilskin coat, turquoise pendant, storybook watercolor.

Templates
- Turnaround: [lock], full-body, neutral pose, front, side and back views, plain pale background, even lighting.
- Portrait: [lock], three-quarter view, [expression], shallow depth, soft side light.
- Action: [lock], full-body, [action] in [location], dynamic pose.
- Expressions: [lock], six head studies in a grid: joy, worry, surprise, stubbornness, sadness, laughter.

Scene 1: [lock] walking a rocky beach at dawn, bending to pick up a green glass shard, low golden light, mist.

Drift checklist: 1. Glasses vanish: put them earlier in the prompt. 2. Coat color shifts: repeat "bright yellow" explicitly. 3. Age creeps: restate "late 60s". 4. Pendant disappears: name its position. 5. Style slides realistic: end every prompt with the style phrase.
prompts.notes: A single frozen paragraph reused verbatim does most of the consistency work. Pair it with a fixed seed or reference image if your tool supports it.

prompts.title: Cinematic shot description with camera, lens and lighting
prompts.description: Describe any scene as a precise cinematic shot, with camera movement, lens, lighting and mood, ready for an AI video or image model.
prompts.body:
You are a cinematographer translating a scene idea into a precise shot description for an AI image or video generator.

Scene: {{scene}}
Emotional tone: {{tone}}
Genre or reference feel: {{genre}}
Camera style: {{camera_style}}
Shot length (for video): {{duration}} seconds

Write {{variations}} alternative shot descriptions. For each one include:
- Shot type and framing (for example wide establishing, medium close-up, over-the-shoulder)
- Camera position and movement, described physically (dolly in, handheld drift, slow crane up)
- Lens and depth of field (focal length feel, aperture look)
- Lighting: key source, direction, quality, color temperature, practical lights
- Color palette and film texture
- Subject action beat by beat across the shot length
- Sound or atmosphere cues if useful, kept to one line

Then provide a single-paragraph version of each shot of 70 words or fewer that can be pasted directly into a generator. Avoid brand names, named living people and ambiguous words like "epic" or "stunning". Output as numbered shots with the paste-ready paragraph at the end of each. No questions; make reasonable choices.

variables.label: Scene
variables.default: A lone night-shift baker opens the shop door to find snow falling on an empty street

prompts.exampleOutput:
Shot 1: Medium wide, slow push-in
Camera: tripod-mounted dolly moving forward very slowly from inside the bakery, framing the open doorway.
Lens: 35mm feel, f/2 look, doorway sharp, street softly blurred.
Lighting: warm tungsten oven glow from behind the baker, cool blue streetlamp light and snow catching it outside, high contrast between the two.
Palette: amber against steel blue, fine grain.
Action: 0-2s baker, flour-dusted apron, pushes the door open; 2-4s steps into the threshold, breath visible; 4-6s looks up as snowflakes drift onto the apron and a faint smile forms.
Atmosphere: muffled silence, distant hum of a fridge.

Paste-ready: Medium wide cinematic shot, slow dolly-in through a bakery doorway, a flour-dusted baker opens the door and watches snow fall on an empty street at night, warm amber oven light behind, cool blue streetlamp glow outside, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens feel, fine film grain, quiet hopeful mood, indie drama.

Shot 2: Close-up on the baker's face from a slightly low angle, handheld micro-drift, 85mm feel, snow reflected in the glasses, the same lighting contrast, a slow exhale, eyes lifting. 6 seconds.
prompts.notes: Describing camera moves physically and splitting action into time beats gives video models far more to work with than adjectives do. Use the paste-ready paragraph as your first draft and tweak one element at a time.

prompts.title: Describe an art style as a reusable prompt
prompts.description: Break down a visual style, whether an era, medium or aesthetic, into precise descriptive terms you can apply to any subject in an image generator.

variables.label: Style to capture
variables.default: Mid-century Japanese travel posters with flat color and bold shapes
variables.help: Describe the look, era or paste a short description of a reference

prompts.exampleOutput:
Style anatomy
- Line: minimal outlines; shapes defined by color edges
- Shapes: simplified, geometric mountains and rooftops, strong diagonals
- Palette: indigo #2B3A67, vermilion #D94F30, ochre #E0A458, cream #F4EBD9, pine #2F5D50
- Texture: slight ink grain, visible registration offsets, matte paper
- Lighting: flat, implied by color contrast, no soft shading
- Composition: tall poster layout, subject offset, generous sky area

Style block: mid-century screenprint poster, flat color fields, bold simplified geometric shapes, limited palette of indigo, vermilion, ochre and cream, slight misregistration, matte paper grain, strong diagonal composition, no gradients, no outlines, travel advertising aesthetic.

Examples
1. A mountain village at dusk, [style block], low angle with rooftops stacked up the slope, a vermilion sun disc.
2. A mountain village at dusk, [style block], viewed from across a lake, mirrored in flat indigo water.
3. A mountain village at dusk, [style block], close crop on a lit window and a pine silhouette.

Failure modes: gradients creep in, so add "no gradients, flat color"; photoreal faces appear, so add "faceless simplified figures".
Short block: flat-color screenprint poster, indigo vermilion cream, geometric shapes, paper grain.
prompts.notes: Translating a vibe into measurable traits (palette, line, texture) gives more repeatable results than naming an artist. Save the short block as a snippet and append it to any subject.

prompts.title: Storyboard to AI video shot list
prompts.description: Convert a script or story beat into a numbered shot list with ready-to-paste video prompts, built to stay consistent across clips.
prompts.body:
You are a video director and prompt engineer preparing an AI-generated video made of short clips.

Story or script:
{{story}}

Total runtime target: {{runtime}} seconds
Max clip length my tool allows: {{clip_length}} seconds
Visual style: {{visual_style}}
Aspect ratio: {{aspect_ratio}}
Main characters and recurring props: {{recurring}}

Do the following:
1. Define a style and continuity header of under 60 words (look, palette, lighting, lens feel, character descriptions) that will be prepended to every shot prompt.
2. Break the story into a numbered shot list that fits the runtime and never exceeds the max clip length. For each shot give: shot number, duration, shot type, camera movement, what happens, and how it connects to the next shot (cut, match cut, continued motion).
3. Write a paste-ready video prompt per shot of 60 words or fewer that includes the action in plain language, camera movement and the subject's position in frame. Do not repeat the header; I will add it.
4. Flag any shot that is risky for current video generators (complex hands, text on screen, crowds, fast physical interaction) and give a simpler alternative.
5. Close with a total duration check.

Present the shot list as a table, with the prompts listed beneath it by shot number. No questions; state assumptions.

variables.label: Story or script
variables.default: A girl finds a glowing paper boat in a puddle, follows it through the rainy city, and releases it into the river at night.

variables.label: Visual style
variables.default: soft animated film, rainy blue palette, warm glowing accents

variables.label: Characters and props
variables.default: A girl of about 8 in a red raincoat, the glowing paper boat

prompts.exampleOutput:
Header: Soft animated film look, rainy blue palette with warm amber glow from the boat, gentle diffused light, shallow depth of field, 16:9. Girl of about 8 with a red raincoat, black bob and yellow boots. Small paper boat glowing warm amber.

Shot list
| # | Sec | Type | Camera | Action | Transition |
| 1 | 6 | Wide | static | Rain on empty street, girl waits at curb | cut |
| 2 | 5 | Close-up | slow push-in | Glowing boat floats in a puddle | match cut |
| 3 | 6 | Medium | tracking | She follows the boat down a gutter stream | continued motion |
| 4 | 6 | Wide | crane up | City lights blur as she runs under neon signs | cut |
| 5 | 7 | Medium wide | slow dolly | At the river she kneels and sets the boat free | end |

Prompts
1. Wide shot, empty rainy city street at dusk, a small girl stands at the curb holding her hood, rain falling steadily, static camera.
2. Close-up of a small paper boat glowing amber on a rain-dimpled puddle, camera pushing in slowly, ripples spreading.

Risk flags: Shot 4 neon text may garble; use unlettered colored lights. Hands in shot 5 are risky; frame from behind her shoulder.
Duration check: 30 seconds.
prompts.notes: A shared continuity header does most of the work of keeping characters and look stable between clips. Generate shots individually and re-roll the weak ones rather than the whole sequence.

prompts.title: YouTube thumbnail concept generator
prompts.description: Get several high-contrast thumbnail concepts with composition, text overlay and an image prompt for each, built around your video's hook.

variables.label: Video title
variables.default: I Built a Tiny Home for Under $5,000

variables.label: Hook or summary
variables.default: Time-lapse of building a 120 sq ft cabin using reclaimed materials, with a surprise cost breakdown at the end
variables.help: What happens or what the viewer learns

prompts.exampleOutput:
CONCEPT 1: "The Receipt"
Single idea: a whole cabin for less than a used laptop.
Composition: finished cabin fills the right two-thirds; creator on the left third looking up in disbelief; price text top left over clean sky.
Text overlay: "$4,870" in extra-bold white sans serif on an orange block. It adds the exact figure the title only rounds to "under $5,000".
Expression and contrast: wide-eyed, mouth open; tiny cabin against a huge price stamp.
Image prompt: Small timber cabin with a corrugated metal roof and reclaimed-wood cladding in a forest clearing, warm late-afternoon light, vivid orange door and window trim, charcoal shadows, high contrast, wide empty sky on the left third for text, sharp focus, photographic style.
Phone check: 6 characters in a solid block, readable at 120px wide.

CONCEPT 2: "From Junk"
Single idea: a pile of scrap becomes a home.
Composition: diagonal split; heap of pallets and old windows lower left, finished cabin interior upper right; text along the dividing line.
Text overlay: "FROM JUNK" in bold orange with charcoal outline. It adds the reclaimed-materials angle the title never mentions.
Expression and contrast: no face needed; messy against tidy.
Image prompt: Split scene, salvaged pallets and window frames on the left, bright tiny-home interior with pale plywood walls, loft bed and orange blanket on the right, natural light, strong contrast, open space along the diagonal for text.
Phone check: the split reads clearly; keep text at 2 words.

CONCEPT 3: "No Plans"
Single idea: the creator improvised the whole build.
Composition: close-up of the creator on the left holding a hammer, bare cabin frame behind on the right; text across the bottom third.
Text overlay: "NO PLANS" in heavy white caps on charcoal. It adds a story hook the title lacks.
Expression and contrast: confident grin; close face against a wide unfinished frame.
Image prompt: Wooden cabin frame under construction in a sunlit field, exposed studs and rafters, tools in the foreground, orange sunset glow, dark empty band along the bottom for text, photographic style.
Phone check: face and hammer stay clear; enlarge the text slightly.

RANKING
1. Concept 1: a concrete number gives curiosity and proof at a glance.
2. Concept 2: a clear transformation, but less specific text.
3. Concept 3: good personality, least information about the result.

A/B TEST: Concept 1 against Concept 2, compared on click-through rate over the first 48 hours.
prompts.notes: Text that adds information beyond the title performs better than text that repeats it. Always test candidates at phone-thumbnail size before committing.

prompts.title: Vague idea to detailed image prompt refiner
prompts.description: Paste a rough idea and get back polished, structured image prompts, plus the choices the model made so you can steer the result.

variables.label: Rough idea
variables.default: a cozy reading nook on a rainy day

prompts.exampleOutput:
Prompt 1 (realistic): Cozy reading nook built into a bay window, deep green velvet cushion, a worn paperback and steaming mug on the sill, rain streaking the glass with a blurred gray garden beyond, warm lamp glow against cool window light, soft wool blanket, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens feel, eye-level composition with space on the right for a headline, muted green, cream and amber palette, photorealistic. --no people, text, clutter

Prompt 2 (illustrated): A flat-color illustration of a window seat with stacked books and a mug, raindrops as diagonal lines on the glass, warm yellow lamp, teal and rust palette, simple shapes, gentle texture, horizontal composition. --no people, text

Prompt 3 (minimal): Minimal composition, single armchair beside a rain-spattered window, beige wall, one lamp, large empty space, soft diffused light, muted tones, photographic.

Assumptions: 1. Horizontal 16:9 for a blog. 2. Evening or overcast daylight. 3. No people. 4. Autumn feel. 5. Space reserved for a headline.
Tweaks: golden-hour, moody, vintage.
prompts.notes: Ordering a prompt by importance gives the subject the most weight. Reviewing the assumptions list is the fastest way to steer the next round.
